findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.oshyn.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_discoverability_assessment, discoverability_assessment_status, get_discoverability_assessment · Private data: start_discoverability_assessment, register_dxp_contact_info, submit_oshyn_contact_request, ask_for_budget_contact_info, query_company_scores, get_advisor_results, ask_for_advisor_contact_info, get_discoverability_assessment, register_budget_contact_info, register_advisor_contact_info, prompt_oshyn_contact_request, ask_for_dxp_contact_info · Public sink: start_discoverability_assessment, submit_oshyn_contact_request, get_discoverability_assessment · Destructive: start_discoverability_assessment, discoverability_assessment_status, get_discoverability_assessment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_discoverability_assessment, discoverability_assessment_status, get_discoverability_assessment · Private data: start_discoverability_assessment, register_dxp_contact_info, submit_oshyn_contact_request, ask_for_budget_contact_info, query_company_scores, get_advisor_results, ask_for_advisor_contact_info, get_discoverability_assessment, register_budget_contact_info, register_advisor_contact_info, prompt_oshyn_contact_request, ask_for_dxp_contact_info · Public sink: start_discoverability_assessment, submit_oshyn_contact_request, get_discoverability_assessment · Destructive: start_discoverability_assessment, discoverability_assessment_status, get_discoverability_assessment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
